titulo: Estar a punto de + infinitive: to be about to do something
subtitulo: Estoy a punto de salir: it's just about to happen.
regla: Estar (conjugated) + a punto de + infinitive = to be about to. In the present perfect it can mean it nearly happened but didn't.

bloques.texto: To say someone is **about to** do something, use **estar** (conjugated) + **a punto de** + **infinitive**.
It works in different tenses: **estoy a punto de**, **estaba a punto de** (often with **cuando** + preterite), **esté a punto de**.
In the preterite (and in the present perfect), it can mean something **nearly happened but didn't**: **estuve a punto de atropellar a un gato** = _I nearly ran over a cat_.
Tip: **a punto** is the point of the wave just before it breaks.

lista.es: ==Estoy a punto de aterrizar== en Tijuana.
lista.en: I'm about to land in Tijuana.
Beto is about to call you.

lista.es: ==Estábamos a punto de salir== cuando llegó mi mamá.
lista.en: We were about to leave when my mom arrived.

lista.es: No creo que ==esté a punto de llover==.
lista.en: I don't think it's about to rain.

lista.es: ==Estuve a punto de atropellar== a un gato.
lista.en: I nearly ran over a cat.

lista.es: La ola ==estaba a punto de romper== cuando me paré.
lista.en: The wave was about to break when I stood up.

lista.texto: What you were going to do: [[6003|iba a]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _The movie is about to start._
lista.r: La película está a punto de empezar.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I was about to call you when you arrived._
lista.r: Estaba a punto de llamarte cuando llegaste.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We nearly lost the keys._
lista.r: Estuvimos a punto de perder las llaves.
